name: Student Pass

requirement_groups.name: Admitted to a registered Malaysian institution

requirements.blocker_text: Requires admission to an institution registered with the Ministry of Higher Education (or relevant ministry), which applies for the Student Pass and Visa Approval Letter (VAL) on the applicant's behalf via the Education Malaysia Global Services (EMGS) system.
requirements.fix_path: Secure admission to a registered Malaysian institution that will process the VAL/Student Pass application through EMGS.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a medical examination (chest X-ray, blood tests) and proof of sufficient funds for tuition and living costs.
requirements.fix_path: Complete the required medical examination and provide financial documentation.

evidence_required.document: Visa Approval Letter (VAL) issued via Education Malaysia Global Services (EMGS)
Proof of funds and admission confirmation

outcome.duration_length: tied to course length, renewed annually

sources.title: eVisa-Card -- Malaysia Visa Requirements 2026: Entry Rules, eVisa & DE Rantau, describing the Student Pass, EMGS process, and medical examination requirement
